references.text: The Lord promised to give rest to the other tribes, which is now fulfilled
The promise of rest in the land that the Lord would give them
Moses gave the land east of the Jordan as an inheritance to the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh
The agreement that the tribes should return to their inherited lands after the conquest
Joshua's reminder to the eastern tribes about Moses' promise of rest and inheritance
The Lord gave Israel rest on all sides, just as he had promised
Moses is referred to as the servant of the Lord, the same title used here
Moses, the servant of the Lord, gave the land east of the Jordan to the eastern tribes
